Subject: NovusHealth — Exec immersion: paired time-bridge proposals and holds

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the productive intro call yesterday. We're excited to run the two-day executive immersion for Novus Health. To make scheduling easier across your UK and West Coast execs, we propose a paired-day approach: one day focused on strategy+roadmap (hybrid), one day for product deep-dive + ops (onsite optional).

Proposed paired-day windows (please pick preferred or provide alternatives):
- Option A: Tue Dec 8 (10:00–14:00 PT / 18:00–22:00 UK) and Wed Dec 9 (10:00–14:00 PT / 18:00–22:00 UK) — good if you want the majority remote with late UK overlap.
- Option B: Wed Dec 15 (08:00–12:00 PT / 16:00–20:00 UK) and Thu Dec 16 (08:00–12:00 PT / 16:00–20:00 UK) — earlier UK-friendly slots, heavier morning PT for onsite participants.
- Option C: Single extended day (Thu Dec 10, 09:00–17:00 PT) with split AV room for live/remote — for teams preferring concentrated engagement.

Logistics notes / asks from our side:
- Headcount: please confirm final attendee list (we'll need a list with titles and "will attend onsite?" flag).
- AV: onsite rooms should support a 65" display + dedicated laptop + wired ethernet for Zoom; we'll bring a back-up hotspot.
- Travel: if you confirm Dec 8–9 onsite, we'll plan two Redwood executives to travel and can share travel windows for approvals.

I've attached a draft agenda and an attendee matrix template to fill in. If you like Option A, I'll issue provisional calendar holds across the Redwood team and create the AV/venue checklist task for our ops partner.

Best —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: exec_workshop_agenda_v1.pdf, attendee_matrix.csv

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear options. After checking with the exec office and the UK leads, Option A (Dec 8–9, late UK-friendly window) works best for the majority remotely. Two of our execs (CFO and Head of Platform) would prefer to be onsite if travel is feasible; the rest will dial in from the UK and Boston.

A few constraints to note:
- UK participants prefer no meeting start before 17:30 GMT (we need that late overlap).
- The CFO has a hard stop at 14:00 PT on both days.
- We need to confirm a hybrid-capable room for up to 12 onsite + 20 remote.

I'll send a finalized attendee list by EOD Monday and confirm which two execs will travel. Please go ahead and put provisional calendar holds for Dec 8–9 (10:00–14:00 PT). Also include an agenda version that keeps the first day ~80% discussion/open planning and the second day 60% product/technical.

Appreciate it —
Claire Jensen
